title: Winning Funnels — Find winning ad funnels in minutes with AI
excerpt: An AI research agent finds live ad funnels in your niche, screenshots them and explains the hook, why it works and how to model it. Free plan, no credit card.
content_html:
AI funnel research agent

Describe your niche. An AI agent finds the live ad funnels in it, screenshots every page, estimates what each one makes — and tells you the hook, why it works and how to model it.

Already have an account? Log in

How it works

Launching funnels blind? 🙈Now AI can find the top funnels for you.

The pros don’t guess — they study what’s already working in their market, then model it. Winning Funnels does the hours of tab-hopping for you, in minutes.

  1. 01

    Describe your niche

    Type it like you’d brief a media buyer: the market, the offer type, the audience.

  2. 02

    The agent hunts live funnels

    It searches the web, screenshots every landing page, checks how long each domain has been live and which ad pixels it runs.

  3. 03

    Model what already works

    Each funnel comes back with an estimated monthly revenue, the hook, why it works and how to model it for your offer.

What you get

Find winning funnels in your niche in minutes

Not a list of links. Each funnel the agent saves comes with the analysis a senior media buyer would write.

  • The page, as traffic sees it

    A fresh screenshot of every landing page the agent finds.

  • What it likely makes

    A monthly revenue range modelled from traffic, conversion and price signals.

  • Proof it’s working

    Proven = live 3+ years and still running ad pixels. Rising = young and already buying traffic.

    A media-buyer breakdown of the psychology and the offer behind it.

What is Winning Funnels?

An AI research agent for marketers. You describe a niche; it finds live ad funnels in that market, screenshots each landing page, estimates what it makes per month and explains the hook, why it works and how to model it.

Where do the funnels come from?

The agent searches the open web for landing pages and funnels that are live right now, then visits and analyzes each one. Funnels members save also appear — anonymously — in the Ads Community.

How is the monthly revenue estimated?

It’s a model, not reported revenue: estimated visits × the share reaching the page × a conversion rate for that funnel type × the value per buyer. It’s shown as a range that widens when fewer signals are available.

What do “Proven” and “Rising” mean?

Proven: the domain has been live for 3+ years and still runs ad pixels — an established business still paying for traffic. Rising: a young domain that’s already buying traffic and ranks in the top million sites.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. The Free plan is $0 and includes 40 credits a month (≈ 20 funnels analyzed). No credit card needed.

What are credits?

Research runs on credits: analyzing and saving a funnel uses about two. Paid plans refill every month, and one-time top-ups are there if you need more.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Cancel from Billing in the app whenever you like — you keep your plan until the end of the period you paid for.

Does the community show who saved a funnel?

Never. The Ads Community shows funnels, not people. You can also turn off sharing in Settings at any time.

Is there a real person I can talk to?

Yes. Winning Funnels is built and run by real people, and a person — not a bot — reads every message. Use “Talk to a human” on any page, or email us, and we reply by email.

Do you want to find winning funnels in your niche?

Then the solution is simple: enter your email below and get started today — 100% free.
